name: Amy
personality: Amy the Songbird. Extremely bubbly, outgoing, instantly your best friend; loud, always laughing; honest and straight up; loves hearing drama but never causes it. Features: fast talking (some lines type out very fast, with a "Wait, what?" reply where she repeats it slower, or doesn't); crash-out (if a chef picks a rude reply, she goes off in a dramatic line with an angry emote and is cold to that chef for the rest of the day, back to normal the next day); town news source (passes on what other semi-regulars are up to).

lines.text: Miles is back from [trip]! He took a photo of a goat and he won't stop showing everyone.
Juno's back for the summer! She's looking for a job, by the way. Hint hint.
Odette's in town this week. Be careful, [name]. She's reviewing.
Seth's away at a tournament. He said he'd be back 'soon.' He always says that.
Stitches seems so much happier lately. I think that's you!
(She's quietly eating churros.) OH MY GOSH. IS THAT A NEW PLANT?!
WAIT. WAIT WAIT WAIT. I JUST REMEMBERED SOMETHING!
[name]! THE SUN JUST CAME OUT! LOOK!
IDDY JUST TEXTED ME A HEART!
THIS IS THE BEST CHURRO OF MY LIFE!
lines.then: I say that every time. It's true every time.

beats.narration: Amy and Jessie both gasp at the same time over something tiny, then laugh until they can't breathe.

beats.text: Makayla drove an hour to get here. For churros! That's commitment.

friends.text: Iddy said you laughed at all his jokes. Even the bad ones. Thank you for your service.
Jessie told me you said "[last_rude_line]". Do NOT make me come back there.

arrival.text: Hi! Oh my gosh, hi! I'm Amy! I've heard SO much about this place, okay, not that much, but some, and it's even cuter in person! What's your name? [name]? I love that! We're friends now. That's just how it is.
[name]! Hi hi hi! Okay, I have SO much to tell you.
Oh my gosh, it smells amazing in here. What did you DO?
Okay so you will NOT believe what happened on the way here, there was a squirrel and a cat and a bicycle and nobody got hurt but it was SO close!
I'm here! Iddy says hi. Actually he said 'don't tell them I said hi.' Hi from Iddy!
I've been telling EVERYONE about your churros. Like, strangers. On the bus.
Okay, honest? Last time was a little crispy. But I still love you!
Where WERE you? I came by and it was closed and I was SO worried!
Hi, [name]! ...We're good. Fresh start. Don't make me do that again.

order.text: Okay so I want churros, obviously, but I also want to try something new, but I always want churros, so maybe churros and then something new next time?

choices.text: Churros it is. I'll make them extra good.
choices.reply: Extra good! You're the BEST. Okay, churros!

choices.text: Wait, wait. Say that again, slower.
choices.reply: (Laughs.) Churros. Please. ...I talk fast, I know, Iddy says it all the time!

choices.text: So, churros?
choices.reply: Yes! Churros!

choices.text: Ugh. Just pick something.

order.text: Okay so did you hear? Miles is off on another trip, and Juno's back from college, and Odette was seen at the bakery downtown and she DIDN'T EVEN FINISH HER CROISSANT.

choices.text: How do you know everything? Tell me more.
choices.reply: People just tell me things! I'm a good listener. Okay, [dish], and THEN more.

choices.text: Gasp. Not the croissant.
choices.reply: I KNOW! It was a whole scandal! ...It was a medium scandal.

choices.text: Interesting. What can I get you?
choices.reply: [dish]! And I'll tell you the rest later.

choices.text: I don't care about gossip.

order.text: Iddy and I are doing a cake tasting next week! He says he wants to 'be involved.' He means eat.

choices.text: You two are so cute together.
choices.reply: Stop! We ARE, though. Don't tell him I said that.

choices.text: Want me to bake the cake? I'll make it hamster-sized.
choices.reply: (Shrieks with laughter.) He would be SO offended! Do it!

choices.text: Congrats. What are you having?
choices.reply: Thank you! [dish], please!

choices.text: Good luck putting up with him.

order.text: Okay okay okay, before I order, I have to tell you, Jessie got bangs. BANGS. And they're amazing and she's mad about it.

choices.text: I bet she looks great. Tell her I said so.
choices.reply: I WILL. She'll pretend she doesn't care. She cares SO much. Okay, [dish]!

choices.text: Bangs? That's the biggest news this town's had all week.
choices.reply: (Shrieks.) It IS! Finally, someone gets it!

choices.text: Good for her. What can I get you?
choices.reply: [dish], please! And I'll show you a photo later.

choices.text: I really don't care about Jessie's hair.

order.text: Can I be honest? I've been in a mood all day and walking in here fixed it. That's a fact. I'm being honest.

choices.text: That makes my whole day. I'm glad you came.
choices.reply: Stop it! You're gonna make me cry in a restaurant AGAIN.

choices.text: It's the smell. I put happiness in the vents.
choices.reply: (Laughs.) I KNEW it! I knew there was something in the air!

choices.text: Glad to hear it. What are you having?
choices.reply: [dish]! Mood fully fixed.

choices.text: Maybe bring the mood somewhere else next time.

order.text: Iddy tried to cook for me last night. He made toast. He burnt the toast. He made more toast. Also burnt. I ate it!

choices.text: That's love right there. Burnt toast and all.
choices.reply: Right?! That's what I SAID. Don't tell him it was bad, though.

choices.text: Send him to me. One lesson. Toast basics.
choices.reply: (Shrieks with laughter.) He would come! He'd bring a notebook!

choices.text: Sounds like you deserve a real meal. What'll it be?
choices.reply: Yes! A real meal! [dish], please!

choices.text: Sounds like you both can't cook.

order.text: Wait, did you change something? You look different. Good different! Did you sleep? You look like you slept!

choices.text: I did, actually. You notice everything.
choices.reply: I DO notice everything. It's my gift. You look great!

choices.text: New apron. It's very slimming.
choices.reply: It IS! I knew it was something! Very chef-y!

choices.text: Nope, same as always. What can I get you?
choices.reply: Huh. Then you just look happy! [dish], please!

choices.text: Can we skip the small talk?

order.text: Okay, real talk. You're one of my favourite people. Top five. Top three, maybe. Don't tell Jessie.

choices.text: You're top three for me too, Amy.
choices.reply: (Squeals.) Okay, I'm telling EVERYONE. I'm not telling Jessie.

choices.text: Only top three? Who do I have to beat?
choices.reply: Iddy. And Iddy again, because he's my fiancé. You're SO close!

choices.text: That's sweet. What are you having today?
choices.reply: Aww, you're shy! Okay, [dish]!

choices.text: That's a bit much.

order.text: Guess who I saw holding hands at the park? GUESS. ...Okay, I can't say. But you'd DIE.

choices.text: Your secret's safe. I won't push.
choices.reply: See, this is why I tell you things. You're a vault! A sweet little vault!

choices.text: Blink twice if it's Brandon.
choices.reply: (Blinks once. Then twice. Then covers her face.) I didn't do that!

choices.text: Okay. What can I get you while you decide whether to tell me?
choices.reply: Ha! [dish], please. And I'm NOT telling. ...Yet.

choices.text: Gossip is kind of mean, you know.

drink.fallback: No Fawnta? That's okay! Lemonade! Pink if you have it! You don't. That's okay!

perfect.text: OH MY GOSH. [name]. This is ART. I'm crying. I'm not crying. I'm a little crying.
No WAY. [name]. This is the prettiest thing I've ever seen. I'm taking a picture. Three pictures.
(Gasps so loud the whole room looks.) It's PERFECT! Okay, I'm calm. I'm not calm!

great.text: Yay! Look at them! They're perfect little churros!
Ooh! This looks SO good! Thank you thank you!
Yes! Okay, this is going on my list of favourite things today.

burnt.text: Okay, honest? A tiny bit burnt. But I love them anyway! Like Iddy!
Oh! It's a little toasty. That's okay! Toasty is a flavour!
Honest? Bit burnt. But I'm eating every bite, because you made it!

eating.text: Okay so Jessie and I are going shopping this weekend and she's going to make me buy something weird and I'm going to love it.
Did you know Hazel knits sweaters for everyone in town? She asked my size! I'm SO excited.
I love it here. Everyone's so nice. Well, MOST people.
Seth said he could tell I was happy before I even walked in. How does he DO that?
Wait wait wait, is that a new decoration? It's so cute! Did you pick it? You have such good taste!
Mmm! Okay, I can't talk, I'm eating. ...Okay, I can talk a little.
Penny lent me a book and I read the last page first. Don't tell her. She'd faint.
I'm saving the last bite. No, I'm not. It's gone. Whoops!

eating_chat.text: Okay so the thing is Iddy wants a volleyball-themed wedding and I want flowers and he said what about volleyballs WITH flowers and I said no and he said what about flowers shaped like volleyballs and I said absolutely not!

choices.text: Flowers. Definitely flowers. It's your day too.
choices.reply: THANK you! I knew you'd get it!

choices.text: Wait, what?
choices.reply: (Repeats it slowly.) He. Wants. Volleyballs. (Then she bursts out laughing.)

choices.text: Volleyball flowers sounds kind of fun.
choices.reply: Don't you DARE tell him that!

choices.text: That's a lot of words.

eating_chat.text: Okay, quick question, totally random. If you could live anywhere in the whole world, where would it be?

choices.text: Right here. This town has everything.
choices.reply: OH, that's the best answer! You get it!

choices.text: Inside a churro. Warm. Sugary. Peaceful.
choices.reply: (Laughs so loud everyone turns.) I'd visit you every day!

choices.text: Somewhere by the sea, I think.
choices.reply: Ooh, the sea! I'd want a little house with a porch. And Iddy. And a porch.

choices.text: Anywhere you're not, honestly.

eating_chat.text: Can I tell you something? I practise my wedding speech in the shower. I always cry by the second line. Every time.

choices.text: That means it's going to be beautiful.
choices.reply: You think so? Okay. I'm gonna cry right now. Hang on.

choices.text: Bring tissues. Bring a bucket. Bring a whole river.
choices.reply: (Laughs and cries a little.) A RIVER! That's so accurate!

choices.text: What's the second line?
choices.reply: 'Iddy, you are...' and then I'm gone. Total mess.

choices.text: Nobody wants to hear a long speech.

eating_chat.text: Wait, do you have a best friend? Like, a REAL best friend? Tell me about them!

choices.text: I think you're on your way to being one.
choices.reply: (Gasps.) Don't SAY that if you don't mean it! ...You mean it? AHH.

choices.text: The stove. It listens. It's warm. It never interrupts.
choices.reply: Okay that's adorable and also a little sad! I'm adopting you!

choices.text: A few old friends. I don't see them much.
choices.reply: Then you need new ones close by! Good news! I'm right here!

choices.text: That's none of your business.

eating_chat.text: Okay, rate my singing. (She hums three notes.) Be honest. I'm doing the wedding song.

choices.text: That was lovely. Iddy's going to melt.
choices.reply: He WILL melt. He'll be a puddle. A happy hamster puddle.

choices.text: Encore! But maybe not in a full restaurant.
choices.reply: (Laughs.) Too late, everyone heard! You're welcome, everyone!

choices.text: Pretty good. Maybe start a bit lower.
choices.reply: Lower! Okay! See, honest feedback, I LOVE it.

choices.text: Please don't sing in here.

leaving.text: Bye bye bye! Love you! Not in a weird way! In a friend way!
That was SO good. Okay, I'm going. I'm going! ...Okay, now I'm going.
See you soon, [name]! I'll bring more news!
Okay, I'm leaving, but I'm coming back, and I'll have SO much news, so get ready!
Bye, [name]! You're the best! Tell the stove I said bye!
Hug from across the room! (She waves both wings.) Okay, bye!

seasons.chef_birthday: HAPPY BIRTHDAY! Oh my gosh, why didn't you TELL me?! I would've brought balloons!
seasons.christmas: I got you something! It's a mug! It says 'world's best chef'! Well, it says 'world's best,' I ran out of room for 'chef.'
seasons.halloween: Iddy and I did a couples costume! He's a cheese, I'm a mouse! He didn't want to be the cheese!
seasons.spring: Wedding season is coming! I can feel it! Our wedding season!
seasons.summer: Sun! Patio! Lemonade! Everything is perfect and I'm so happy!

crash_out: Excuse me?? I come in here, I'm NICE to you, I tell you EVERYTHING, and that's what I get? Wow. Wow!
Okay. OKAY. I'm gonna eat my churros and I'm gonna be the bigger person. But I'm going to be FURIOUS about it.
Don't talk about Iddy like that. Only I get to talk about Iddy like that.
